map.总分 = 恐惧分合计 + 回避分合计（各条目0-3）；按表现型/社交型拆分；满分: Total = sum of fear + sum of avoidance (each item 0-3); split by performance/social type; max = items x 3 x 2.

map.总分范围0-144，>30提示可能社交焦虑障碍，>60高度可能，>90严重: Total range 0-144; >30 suggests possible social anxiety disorder, >60 highly likely, >90 severe
